hypothesis: Non-financial HS300 firms with simultaneous improvement in profitability, cash conversion, leverage, gross margin and asset turnover should earn higher future returns than firms with weak accounting quality.
selection_basis: R246 found that a single free-cash-flow signal was strong in discovery but not in validation. R247 tests a broad, equal-weighted accounting-quality score built from seven economically distinct annual signals already available in the local financial contract. The design was frozen after a no-forward-return coverage and correlation audit; the maximum mean absolute monthly correlation with existing factors was 0.291102. Evidence: data/strategies/ai/.iterations/ai_hs300_multi_factor_rank/evidence/r247_data_feasibility.json

factor.interpretation: Higher means more of the seven annual accounting-quality signals improved simultaneously.
factor.pit_rule: Annual reports only. The effective date is statutory reporting deadline + 3 calendar days. The latest annual report expires after 500 calendar days. Missing components remain null; no partial score is produced.
factor.missing_data_rule: If any component cannot be computed, the score is null and is never filled with zero or a partial sum.
factor.universe: historical HS300 membership excluding banks and non-bank financials using the current industry snapshot

strategies.weight_rationale: The accounting-quality score receives 45%; the remaining quality and cash weights preserve the same 54.5/45.5 ratio used by the matched controls.
strategies.matched_requirements: Both strategies use the same non-financial HS300 universe, score-factor availability filter, 30-name score limit, top 10 equal-weight positions, 20-day holding period, -20% stop loss, T+1 open execution, and cost model.

execution.cost_stress: 4x and 5x scale all four cost components proportionally

segments.stitching: compound two independently run segment curves; skip the first return of each later segment

factor_ic.method: month-end factor value versus T+1 open to T+21 open forward return within historical non-financial HS300 members; cross-sectional Spearman rank IC

gates.D1: full-period non-financial member-row factor coverage from 2023-05-04 onward >= 0.99
gates.D3: two consecutive annual reports used; seven components fixed; no partial score and no current-list filling
gates.D4: maximum mean absolute monthly rank correlation with the preregistered existing-factor set <= 0.70
gates.I1: discovery mean rank IC >= 0.02 with at least 18 month-end observations
gates.I2: validation mean rank IC >= 0.01 with at least 18 month-end observations and the same positive sign
gates.G2: discovery candidate MDD is no worse than control MDD by more than 5pp
gates.G4: full-sample candidate return > 0 and >= control return
gates.G5: full-sample candidate MDD <= 40% in absolute value and no worse than control by more than 5pp
gates.G6: rolling 1-year positive rate >= 60% and no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G7: recent 12-month candidate return > 0 and MDD no worse than control by more than 5pp
gates.G8: full-sample candidate return at 4x cost is positive
gates.G9: full-sample candidate return at 5x cost is positive
gates.C1: at least 30 distinct symbols are traded across the full sample
gates.C2: the largest symbol's share of net P&L is <= 25%
gates.C3: the top three symbols' share of net P&L is <= 55%
gates.C4: the top five symbols' share of net P&L is <= 75%
gates.C5: at least 8 distinct symbols have positive P&L in the validation segment
gates.C6: the largest industry's share of gross profit is <= 45%
gates.C7: the largest single-symbol loss is <= 20% of gross profit in absolute value

decision_rule: All D, I, G and C gates must pass. Any failure means the factor is not accepted and cannot be rescued by changing components, annual window, weights, holding period, stop loss, universe, costs or gates after seeing results.
known_limitations: Only seven of the traditional Piotroski signals are available; current-ratio and share-issuance components are not present in the local contract.
The factor updates annually and can be stale within a fiscal year.
The first valid score is 2023-05-04 because two consecutive annual reports are required.
Financial values are current snapshots and may contain restatements.
The industry snapshot used to exclude financials is current rather than historical PIT.
Passing these gates would justify further paper-trading validation, not production deployment.
